### Verification queue priorities: move committed jobs up or down later, and run only the top of the queue

change `ozupovnmpzuv` · [log `60bc21576206`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/3761db96-b870-47f7-aded-2ba264c165f4/60bc21576206b799b4edbd15f0fa480d7f61fc75f0212509984e0a24793f61f8.jsonl.gz)

Job files are committed with the change they verify and not edited after, so a job's own priority was fixed at submit time and no job set one. verification/priorities.json now holds priorities by job id, each with a reason, set with 'pipeline.py prioritize ID... --priority N --reason TEXT' (--clear, no ids lists them). It overrides the job's own priority and is read at the same commit as the jobs. 'run --min-priority N' runs only the jobs at N or above and leaves the rest pending; 'status' lists pending jobs in start order with their priorities and says when priorities.json has uncommitted changes.
